_description: Vendor emails AP asking 'Where is my payment for INV-ACS-2026-0042?' — routes to vendor_comms_agent (inquiry_response mode) which checks status + drafts a response.

payload.subject: Re: Outstanding Invoice INV-ACS-2026-0042
payload.body_text:
Hello AP team,

I'm following up on our invoice INV-ACS-2026-0042 dated 2026-06-01 for $4,200 (June subscription renewal). The payment terms are Net30 so it should be due by 2026-07-01. We have not received any confirmation that it's been scheduled. Could you let me know the expected pay date?

Thanks,
Lena (Acme Cloud Billing)
